live.planWorking: Claude is working on {n} tasks of this plan
diff.label: Difficulty: {level}
drawer.label: Details
import.title: Import plans
import.lead: Bring in plans saved as Markdown (.md) files anywhere on this computer. Plan Atlas keeps its own copy; your files are never changed.
import.ignored: {n} other files were left out: only .md plans are imported (hidden and build folders are skipped).
import.ignoredOne: 1 other file was left out: only .md plans are imported (hidden and build folders are skipped).
import.tooMany: Too many files: import at most {max} at a time.
import.tooBigTotal: The files add up to more than 20 MB. Import them in smaller groups.
import.hint: Plans on this computer can also be imported from a terminal:
drawer.notStarted: Claude has not worked on this yet. Once it starts, you will see every step here.
drawer.openBoard: Filter the task board by this topic
drawer.otherPlans: click to see other plans with this topic
plan.lead: Tasks of this plan by status. Drag a card to another column to change its status, click a card for details.
home.title: Overview
home.lead: Every plan Claude writes, in every project, is gathered here. Click a plan to read it and follow its progress.
home.empty: No plans yet. Ask Claude to plan something and it will show up here.
project.title: Project {name}
board.title: Task board
board.lead: All tasks across your plans. Drag a card to another column to change its status; click a card for details (the board stays open).
board.dragHint: Drag and drop only works when grouped by status.
map.title: Knowledge map
map.lead: Each circle is a plan. An arrow joins two plans when one needs or builds on the other; a dashed line joins plans that share a topic. Pick a topic on the left to see which plans it touches.
map.hint: Click a circle to see the plan summary without leaving the map.
search.label: Search
search.footer: ↑ ↓ to select · Enter to open · Esc to close · accents optional
search.none: No results for “{q}”. Try another keyword, for example: {examples}
activity.title: What Claude is doing
plan.importedHint: This plan was written outside the standard Plan Atlas layout (for example before Plan Atlas was installed), so it has no task list to track.
plan.pageLead: A plan Claude wrote for project {project}. Read the document below, or open “Tasks” to follow progress.
plan.taskHint: Click a task to see its details and what Claude is doing.
plan.noTasks: This plan has no task list, so there is nothing to track here. You can still read it under “Document”.
plan.notFound: This plan could not be found. It may have been moved or deleted.
rel.out.depends_on: This plan depends on {link} being done first
warn.title: Plan Atlas noticed some problems in this plan file. The plan is still shown, but some parts may be missing or not shown as intended.
warn.non_utf8: Some characters in the file could not be read and were replaced.
warn.missing_frontmatter: The file has no information block at the top (project, title, topics), so defaults were used.
warn.invalid_frontmatter: Part of the information block at the top of the file could not be understood and was ignored.
warn.invalid_task_metadata: A task has a setting (such as difficulty or status) with a value that was not understood.
warn.duplicate_task_id: Two tasks use the same number, so one of them may not be shown.
warn.unknown_tag: A topic in this plan is not in the list of known topics.
warn.missing_section: One of the standard sections (01–05) is missing.
warn.other: Something in the file could not be read as expected.
live.planWorkingOne: Claude is working on 1 task of this plan
live.openTask: Click to see this task's details
project.lead: {plans} · {done}/{total} tasks done. Click a plan to read it and follow its progress.
project.empty: No plans in this project yet.
plan.pageLeadNoTasks: A plan Claude wrote for project {project}. It has no task list, so there is just the document to read.
board.empty: No tasks yet. Tasks appear here once Claude writes a plan with a task list.
drawer.taskNotFound: This task could not be found. It may have been renamed or removed from the plan.
drawer.idle: Claude is not working on this right now. Here is what it did:
activity.lead: Live updates. Each “assistant” is a Claude agent working in parallel to get things done faster.
map.legendRing: Green ring: share of tasks done · Number: tasks
